description.p: OmaCalendar is a keyboard-friendly calendar application for Omarchy Linux. A local daemon owns synchronization and storage so cached calendars remain available when network providers are offline.
The planned 1.0 release supports local calendars, Google Calendar, generic CalDAV, and read-only iCalendar subscriptions.

Build-environment replacement that obtains Flatpak tools only from Ubuntu's signed package sources. Runtime behavior is unchanged from RC4; exact artifacts and remaining provider and owner acceptance require fresh qualification.

Replacement candidate with recurrence, CalDAV synchronization, conflict chronology, local date selection, and accessibility fixes found during expanded acceptance testing. Exact artifacts and complete provider and desktop acceptance require fresh qualification.

Replacement candidate correcting Flatpak bundle inventory and GitHub-safe Debian filenames. Exact downloaded artifacts require fresh verification; runtime logic and pending owner acceptance gates are unchanged.

Replacement paired release candidate after the widget RC1 tagger email could not be verified. Version metadata and documentation change only; runtime behavior and pending acceptance gates are unchanged.
Release candidate with Arch, Debian, and Flatpak packages for acceptance testing. Stable owner and live-provider acceptance remain pending.
Public beta for current Omarchy with an attested native package, Google Calendar authorization, and IPC 2 widget compatibility.
Unsupported evaluation prerelease for test calendars; stable provider and owner-acceptance gates remain open.
